verdict: Material spec and integration gaps reproduced. General run authenticates observations; it does not independently prove arbitrary worker-controlled tests truthful.
method: Inventory all 52 ADRs and 192 tracked prior-art artifacts, with content hashes and grouped claim/scope review. Historical vendored sources and ADRs remain unchanged.
Clone and frozen-install the release and corrected HEAD; vendor each exact src tree into pinned benjaminp/six c8e394065cd541a16c040515dc0afb85cf22a7c3.
Measure the real external suite (200 collected, 185 passed, 15 skipped), then explicitly freeze and run its 185 passing IDs. The baseline skip set is not a claim of universal platform coverage.

Use real CLI subprocesses, fresh external keys, actual signed observations, real Git mutations and SQLite corruption. Independently verify Ed25519 with OpenSSL and broken-code behavior with an ordinary Python assertion.

Probe the production receiver with actual HTTP sockets, signed local fixture deliveries, an unavailable local Git remote, and process restarts. No mocked GitHub response stands in for a live App journey.
Independently refetch all 52 unambiguous raw-source NOTICE mappings over HTTPS: all 52 match the complete local bytes.
Run real native confinement, strict-local I/O, dynamic-runtime tampering, timeout/descendant cleanup, and independent approved-batch qualification under an explicitly delegated systemd scope.
Run the broad repository suite and extra tooling/opt-in checks; retain failures and named skips, including exploratory setup errors caused by our own dirty tree.
